name: Opal Aggregate AUA -- Multi-Partner Model Portfolio Asset Tracking
description: Evolve the Model Portfolios portal page's 'Opal AUA' from a structurally single-tenant 49 Financial view (SmartX-scraped model holdings + a frozen non-model plug) into a partner-decomposed aggregate. Opal is no longer single-tenant -- Inflection is onboarding actively (~$96M to date), Cottonwood follows. Canonical architecture: Opal Aggregate AUA = sum over partners of (model AUA + non-model AUA), with a first-class `partner`/firmId dimension on every row, sourced from partner-specific custodian pipelines (49F via SmartX, Inflection via Eclipse/Orion, extensible), plus an ETF ownership decomposition attributing each Opal ETF's total net-assets (DIVZ/IDVZ/PFDE/PFOE) across 49F-held + Inflection-held + public residual. The portal Model Portfolios page gets a 'Select Partners:' control architected identically to the ADVI firmId partner-scoping pattern -- default Aggregate, per-partner filter. Consolidates four previously-separate threads (SmartX REST ingestion, TrueShares ETF net-assets ingestion, the 49F non-model AUM derivation, Inflection Eclipse model tracking) into one macro_project per Andrew direct directive 2026-05-18.

depends_on_note: MDPF_ASSETS is the umbrella consuming/reconciling project; the three feeders are ingestion substrate. Per PRD section 6.1 CTO boundary ruling: MDPF_ASSETS does NOT formally `absorb` the in-flight feeders (that would orphan their live TOs) -- their current TOs complete under their own codes. MDPF_ASSETS depends_on them and is the single home for all NEW model-portfolio-AUA work going forward.
